source: &23 Intruder!
&599 The conspicuously large hatch in the floor is apparently how crates are lifted into the cargo bay.
target: &599 地板上这扇显眼的大舱口，应该就是货箱被吊进货舱的地方。

source: &600 Watch your step!
&601 You see the city pass slowly underneath you - good thing you've got a head for heights.
target: &601 你看着城市在脚下缓缓经过。幸好，你不怕高。

source: &725 It doesn't appear to be operated by hand. Your sense for systems tells you the console is what controls it.
target: &725 看起来，它不是手动操作的。你对系统的感知告诉你，是那台控制台在控制它。

source: &1696 Looks like it's not operated by hand.
&1486 That door leads to a kilometer-long, gravity assisted trip straight to the heart of the city.
target: &1486 出了那扇门，就会在重力帮助下，直奔一公里下方的市中心。

source: &604 Judging by the diagrams you can see through the surface of the screen, the console appears to control a loading hatch.
target: &604 根据屏幕表面下透出的图示，控制台似乎操控着装货舱口。

source: &605 The thinness of the steel wall has allowed the thermal outline of the hired heavy to be visible from this side.
target: &605 钢壁很薄，所以从这一侧，就能看见雇佣打手的热成像轮廓。

source: &1697 It's thin, but it's not *that* flimsy.
target: &1697 是很薄，可也没*那么*脆弱。

source: &1698 I'm gonna need to find another way of getting through to him...
target: &1698 得另想办法，穿过去对付他……

source: &606 The crate is stamped 'U-ADS/148'. You are unsure what used to be in the now-opened container, but it looks military-grade.
target: &606 货箱上印着“U-ADS/148”。这个已经打开的箱子，之前装的是什么，你不清楚，但看起来属于军用品。

source: Picked up: AP Ammunition
&1206 I wonder what this was for.
target: &1206 不知道这是做什么用的。

source: &726 Deeper into the heart of the aerostat.
